title: Grafana Dashboards Configuration
description: A JSON schema for a TOML configuration file for downloading Grafana dashboards.

datasource.description: Datasource override for the dashboard. Can be a string (for a single datasource) or a map of template variable names to datasource names.

url.description: Direct URL to the dashboard JSON. 'url' and 'id' are mutually exclusive.

id.description: Grafana.com dashboard ID. Used to construct the URL if 'url' is not provided. 'url' and 'id' are mutually exclusive.

revision.description: Dashboard revision number. Used with 'id' to construct the URL.

dashboard.description: Configuration for a single Grafana dashboard.
